source: Official RoboDojo task/RoboDojo/tasks/*.py, pinned source commit 726e9aabfaa642203722eb126f5eaf0f37f3e1ad; static acceptance descriptions, never current rewards
stack_blocks: Stack all three differently textured blocks (any order), release them, and return BOTH robot arms to their reset joint postures with fingers open. A visually finished tower alone is insufficient without returning home.
general_pickup: Identify the object described by the instruction and raise its physical origin strictly more than 0.10 metre above its reset height. Retain it during lift. No release or home return is required before success.
fold_clothes: Fold both sleeves inward toward the opposite chest, then fold both hem corners toward the corresponding shoulders. The geometric intervals below apply to displacement projected onto the GARMENT'S LOCAL +X/+Y axes, NOT world X/Y. Use differences of observed point_local_x/point_local_y variables for these checks; continue using world point_x/y/z for hand motion targets. After release, left_sleeve minus right_chest local X must be strictly between -0.125 and 0.14, local Y between -0.125 and 0.14; right_sleeve minus left_chest local X between -0.14 and 0.125, local Y between -0.125 and 0.14. Each hem minus its corresponding shoulder local X must be strictly between -0.12 and 0.12, local Y between -0.095 and 0.17; the angle between the hem and shoulder lines must be below 45 degrees. Finish with both grippers open and BOTH arms back at reset wrist poses. The native home region permits at most 0.15 m displacement on each wrist world axis and at most 20 degrees wrist rotation from reset; returning reset joints is one way to establish this. Native checks are triggered when hands enter home with fingers open, so finish and release folds before entering home. Exact point coincidence is not required. Do not shrink these terminal geometric intervals for a self-imposed safety margin; interior margins are motion targets only. Current deformed named points are measurements, not reward booleans.
press_by_number: Read the two number cards from images. Press and FULLY release the corresponding first red button that many times, then press and fully release the blue confirmation button. Repeat for the second red button and confirm again with blue. Finish by returning BOTH arms to reset postures. Correct counts and order both matter; a button must reset fully before another press counts.
match_and_pick_from_conveyor: Observe and remember the FIRST object on the conveyor, then identify its matching repeat when it appears and lift that repeated matching object strictly more than 0.10 metre. Do not lift a different object merely because it is reachable. Use temporal observation and allow the native conveyor to progress while waiting.
stack_bowls: Nest/stack all three bowls with their local +Z axes upward; the lowest bowl must remain almost level (within 7 degrees), the others within 45 degrees. Release and return BOTH robot arms to reset joint postures with fingers open. All three bowl centers must form a vertical stack (horizontal offset below 4 cm).
